tax.text: Allen introduced a bill providing a tax credit of up to $10,000 for eligible disaster-rebuilding purchases.
tax.quote: This tax credit would offer needed financial relief to provide disaster survivors with a more stable pathway to a successful recovery effort.

housing.text: Allen said he wants to restrict new construction in high-risk areas and consider incentives for current residents to move elsewhere.
housing.quote: As part of reducing risk, he wants to restrict new construction in high-risk zones

transit.text: Allen has authored legislation described as supporting green transit.
transit.quote: Senator Allen has authored crucial legislation in the areas of economic development, environmental protection, climate change, green transit, educational equity, government transparency, insurance, and electoral reform.

tax.text: As a San Francisco supervisor, she passed a tax on multimillion-dollar commercial real estate to fund universal affordable childcare.
tax.quote: passing a tax on multimillion-dollar commercial real estate that now raises over $140 million annually to make universal affordable childcare a reality

housing.text: As a San Francisco supervisor, she raised the affordable-housing requirement for development projects from 12% to 25% and secured 40% requirements in three projects.
housing.quote: She also led and won the fight to raise the city’s affordable housing mandate from 12% to 25%, and secured an unprecedented 40% requirement in three major development projects within her district.

safety.text: She sponsored a San Francisco task force that recommended alternatives to financial penalties, bail and incarceration, including community service and pretrial diversion.
safety.quote: increasing the use of current alternatives such as the Pretrial Diversion Project

immigration.text: She joined a protest against federal immigration agents’ presence at San Francisco International Airport and was arrested after blocking access to the terminal.
immigration.quote: former supervisor Jane Kim, blocked the street to the international terminal
